role: Historical references on new source-heldout development only; no candidate promotion or final acceptance

hiesp.runner_and_binary_pins: GPU must freeze actual runner/QEMU/ELF/flash SHA256 before official inference; this plan alone does not authorize unpinned engine replay.
hiesp.paired_metadata_policy: Create an exact derived replay manifest binding the original generation manifest and generator-reference endpoint semantics. Existing paired validator must explicitly accept its frozen metadata; do not masquerade as a transport probe or invent human endpoint labels.

source_policy: Every original WAV in manifest order; authenticate entire cohort before model load. Preserve full PCM/native speed. No trimming, gate-based source exclusions, retries or regenerated audio.
v30_policy: Reset frontend/model per clip; application zero prime56160, then full source plus final zero padding to480. Two exact model replays. Shared existing host and firmware event policies, five scores,67-step refractory. Retain both policy event lists and any differences. One-based raw score step s returns at480*(s+1)-56160 source samples.
classification_policy: Report whole-source/padded-tail any-event and generator-prefix [-100,+800]ms window separately. Signed first-event and window-first-event timing; premature/late counts retained. Nyx Nick/Next/Mix common confusers; Hi ESP opposite phrase. Break out voices/conditions and bare vs command; do not treat variants as independent speakers.
background_policy: No continuous background in this126-clip study. Report no FAR or matched-FAR conclusion. Do not substitute inserted lead/trailing silence or pooled different historical stages for a background test.
candidate_policy: This v1 executes historical v30 only; official Hi ESP is a separate pinned GPU run. No in-progress formal checkpoint, failed model rescue, threshold search or training updates. Any future candidate requires a separate byte-pinned historical-threshold profile after its original regression gate; final sets untouched.
limits: Two correlated Piper target voices, not independent TTS families or126 independent people. LibriVox reader/pretraining overlap unknown.
Generator token duration is a synthesis reference, not verified acoustic phonetic timing. Signed audio-time events are not wall-clock hardware latency.
Native detectors keep their different fixed block/prime/internal trigger policies; preserve every source PCM byte and disclose geometry.
Fixed historical thresholds were chosen elsewhere; no matched general-population FAR calibration or representative recall claim.
No playback, recording, device flashing, production-board access or final testing. No human listening/recording prerequisite for this synthetic research.
